en: A black‑and‑white postcard view showing a massive crowd of people, mostly men in early‑20th‑century coats, hats, and caps, marching or gathering on a cobblestone area. In the background stands a large, ornate theater or opera‑house style building with a mansard roof, domes, and classical detailing, surrounded by other urban buildings and a church tower at right. The scene suggests a political demonstration or public gathering in a European city.
